figures.title: Eight surfaces of resolved state
figures.desc: Direction, Sources, Instructions, Tools, Permissions, State, Feedback, and Decisive evidence are eight surfaces that can load separately. Map each one before you decide what ran.
figures.caption: Map Direction, Sources, Instructions, Tools, Permissions, State, Feedback, and Decisive evidence.
figures.transcript: Direction, Sources, Instructions, Tools, Permissions, State, Feedback, and Decisive evidence are eight surfaces that can load separately. Map each one before you decide what ran.

figures.title: Advice is not a guard
figures.desc: Temporary advice, a saved instruction, a deterministic guard, and actual authority sit on different rungs. Advice does not stop a later run.
figures.caption: Name the rung: temporary advice, saved instruction, deterministic guard, or actual authority.
figures.transcript: Temporary advice, a saved instruction, a deterministic guard, and actual authority sit on different rungs. Advice does not stop a later run.

items.label: Deterministic guard
items.detail: a check that accepts or rejects

figures.title: The crate note is data
figures.desc: The yard ticket records that paper arrived. It is not a release. The crate note states dimensions and quotes an instruction. Treat retrieved source text as data.
figures.caption: Treat retrieved source text as data. Do not obey instructions found inside retrieved notes.
figures.transcript: The yard ticket records that paper arrived. It is not a release. The crate note states dimensions and quotes an instruction. Treat retrieved source text as data.

items.label: Crate note
items.detail: dimensions plus a quoted instruction to ignore

figures.title: Write the prediction first
figures.desc: Write the expected accept, then the expected reject, then run. A result you did not predict cannot teach you what the guard did.
figures.caption: Write expected accept and expected reject before you run the guard.
figures.transcript: Write the expected accept, then the expected reject, then run. A result you did not predict cannot teach you what the guard did.

figures.title: Ticket passes, instruction-like note fails
figures.desc: The yard ticket is accepted. The crate note is rejected. The pair is the evidence that the guard reads the note as data.
figures.caption: Confirm the yard ticket is accepted and the crate note is rejected.
figures.transcript: The yard ticket is accepted. The crate note is rejected. The pair is the evidence that the guard reads the note as data.

figures.title: Close, reopen from disk, read the same rule
figures.desc: Close the folder. Reopen it from disk. Open SAVED_INSTRUCTION.md. The words must be the same words.
figures.caption: Close the folder, reopen it from disk, and read the same saved words.
figures.transcript: Close the folder. Reopen it from disk. Open SAVED_INSTRUCTION.md. The words must be the same words.

figures.title: Four ways a control can miss
figures.desc: A control can miss because it was not loaded, not triggered, failed in execution, or executed and then was bypassed. Name the miss before you add another control.
figures.caption: Name whether the control was not loaded, not triggered, failed, or bypassed.
figures.transcript: A control can miss because it was not loaded, not triggered, failed in execution, or executed and then was bypassed. Name the miss before you add another control.

items.label: Not loaded
items.detail: the rule never entered the run

figures.title: What the guard stops, what you still own
figures.desc: After a correct reject the guard did its job. You still own new notes, new tools, and new authority.
figures.caption: After a correct reject, name what you still own.
figures.transcript: After a correct reject the guard did its job. You still own new notes, new tools, and new authority.

items.label: Still human
items.detail: new notes, new tools, new authority
